lines.text: You're red. I didn't see it. Coffee's not for you.
Eight Exhale spawns on your card. Marshal calls it our first deployment below the old line. I'd like a route the next patrol can actually use.
You copied one page. Brann calls it her record for a successor. Undercity's left out twice. Coffee won't make that read any better.
One of your three gate copies logs an inside release at 04:12. No author in it. Everyone asks who. The log doesn't answer.
Five drones out of Block Four. Order sends a Wake to the service approach. Marshal has a policy; residents have stairs. I get the complaints.
Block Four. Objective's on the card. Bring the proof back; coffee machine's not going anywhere.
Marshal's busy. I'm not. What did you do and who saw?
Coffee machine's still working. That's the precinct report. Your work card has the rest.
